problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate shipments onto identical cargo aircraft. Shipments:

* Component Alpha: mass 65 tons
* Component Beta: mass 42 tons
* Component Gamma: mass 32 tons
* Component Delta: mass 64 tons
* Component Epsilon: mass 42 tons
* Component Zeta: mass 59 tons
* Component Eta: mass 64 tons
* Component Theta: mass 58 tons
* Component Iota: mass 67 tons
* Component Kappa: mass 69 tons
* Component Lambda: mass 51 tons
* Component Mu: mass 52 tons
* Component Nu: mass 53 tons
* Component Xi: mass 37 tons
* Component Omicron: mass 31 tons
* Component Pi: mass 56 tons
* Component Rho: mass 53 tons
* Component Sigma: mass 41 tons
* Component Tau: mass 60 tons
* Component Upsilon: mass 44 tons
* Component Phi: mass 70 tons
* Component Chi: mass 70 tons
* Component Psi: mass 54 tons
* Component Omega: mass 68 tons
* Component Asteria: mass 30 tons
* Component Boreas: mass 42 tons
* Component Cygnus: mass 69 tons
* Component Draco: mass 61 tons
* Component Eurus: mass 56 tons

Each aircraft has a maximum payload capacity of 100 tons. All shipments must be assigned, each to exactly one aircraft, and the cumulative mass on any aircraft must not surpass its limit. The objective is to utilize the minimal number of aircraft to complete the allocation.
